tasks.question: vLLM 用什么机制管理 attention 的 key/value memory？
tasks.gold_answer: vLLM 使用 PagedAttention 管理 attention key 和 value memory。

gold_evidence.quote: Efficient management of attention key and value memory

tasks.question: SGLang 用什么技术做 prefix sharing？
tasks.gold_answer: SGLang 使用 RadixAttention 做 exact token-level prefix caching。

gold_evidence.quote: exact token-level prefix caching (SGLang RadixAttention)

tasks.question: TensorRT-LLM 如何优化 LLM inference？
tasks.gold_answer: TensorRT-LLM 用 specialized kernels、高效 runtime 和 Pythonic framework 优化 LLM inference。

gold_evidence.quote: TensorRT LLM optimizes inference for LLMs and Visual Gen models with specialized kernels

tasks.question: LangGraph 的定位是什么？
tasks.gold_answer: LangGraph 是用于构建 stateful agents 的低层 orchestration framework。

gold_evidence.quote: Low-level orchestration framework for building stateful agents.

tasks.question: KV cache 在长上下文推理中为什么会成为瓶颈？
tasks.gold_answer: KV cache 随 sequence length 和 batch size 线性增长，解码受内存带宽限制。

gold_evidence.quote: grows linearly with sequence length and batch size

tasks.question: KeepKV 的核心方法是什么？
tasks.gold_answer: KeepKV 使用 adaptive KV cache merging，在严格内存约束下保持性能。

gold_evidence.quote: a novel adaptive KV cache merging method designed to preserve performance under strict memory constraints

tasks.question: Tamarin 的压缩结构是什么？
tasks.gold_answer: Tamarin 使用三层可逆压缩：4-bit focal tier、3-bit group summary tier、CPU-RAM archive。

gold_evidence.quote: a three-tier reversible compression scheme

tasks.question: Apt-Serve 主要解决什么瓶颈？
tasks.gold_answer: Apt-Serve 解决 TTFT SLO attainment 下降，根因是 KV cache 限制 batch size 和 FCFS 调度僵化。

gold_evidence.quote: significant decline in Time To First Token (TTFT) SLO attainment

tasks.question: OrbitFlow 用什么方法决定 KV cache 的层级管理？
tasks.gold_answer: OrbitFlow 用轻量 ILP solver 决定哪些层的 KV cache 放在哪里，以满足长上下文 serving 的 SLO。

gold_evidence.quote: OrbitFlow employs a lightweight ILP solver

tasks.question: Secure-RAG 评估哪些维度？
tasks.gold_answer: Secure-RAG 评估 factual accuracy、hallucination avoidance、adversarial robustness、bias/fairness、toxicity、security 和 calibration。

gold_evidence.quote: factual accuracy, hallucination avoidance, adversarial robustness, bias and fairness, toxicity, security, and calibration

tasks.question: vLLM 和 SGLang 在 KV cache/prefix 管理上的核心差异是什么？
tasks.gold_answer: vLLM 用 PagedAttention 管理 attention key/value memory；SGLang 用 RadixAttention 做 exact token-level prefix caching。

gold_evidence.quote: Efficient management of attention key and value memory
exact token-level prefix caching (SGLang RadixAttention)

tasks.question: KeepKV 和 Tamarin 对 KV cache 压缩的取舍有什么不同？
tasks.gold_answer: KeepKV 用 adaptive merging 保留更多信息；Tamarin 用三层可逆压缩，避免 eviction/merge 永久丢失未来才相关的信息。

gold_evidence.quote: a novel adaptive KV cache merging method designed to preserve performance under strict memory constraints
a three-tier reversible compression scheme

tasks.question: EMPIRIC 和 KeepKV 分别关注 KV cache 压缩的什么目标？
tasks.gold_answer: EMPIRIC 关注同时降低 computation、storage 和 latency；KeepKV 关注 periodic lossless compression，通过 merging 保持性能。

gold_evidence.quote: few methods effectively achieve both simultaneously
a novel adaptive KV cache merging method designed to preserve performance under strict memory constraints

tasks.question: Apt-Serve 和 OrbitFlow 如何缓解长上下文 serving 的 KV cache 压力？
tasks.gold_answer: Apt-Serve 做 adaptive request scheduling on hybrid cache；OrbitFlow 做细粒度 KV cache reconfiguration 和 offloading，减少 CPU-GPU transfer。

gold_evidence.quote: significant decline in Time To First Token (TTFT) SLO attainment
OrbitFlow employs a lightweight ILP solver

tasks.question: Traditional RAG 和 Agentic RAG 的核心区别？
tasks.gold_answer: Traditional RAG 用固定的 single-pass retrieval；Agentic RAG 用 autonomous agents 做 planning、迭代检索、工具调用和中间推理。

gold_evidence.quote: Traditional RAG employs a fixed, single-pass retrieval process
Agentic RAG extends this framework with autonomous agents that plan, iterate retrieval, integrate tools, and reason over intermediate results

tasks.question: 多跳 RAG 中 query decomposition 和 cross-encoder reranking 分别解决什么问题？
tasks.gold_answer: query decomposition 把复杂问题拆成 self-contained sub-questions；cross-encoder reranking 在每一步重排候选，缓解 dense retrieval 的 semantic drift。

gold_evidence.quote: decomposes complex queries into self-contained sub-questions and employs a Cross-Encoder to rerank candidates

tasks.question: RAG reranking 如何利用 follow-up query prediction？
tasks.gold_answer: 把 LLM 预测的 follow-up queries 和初始 query 结合，用 fine-tuned weighting 重新排序，更好捕捉演化中的用户意图。

gold_evidence.quote: incorporating LLM-generated predicted follow-up queries coupled with the initial user query

tasks.question: Secure-RAG 如何评估 RAG 的 security 和 reliability？
tasks.gold_answer: 它在 query、retrieval、generation 每个阶段加 lightweight monitors，做 factual accuracy、hallucination、adversarial robustness、bias、toxicity、security、calibration 等多维评估。

gold_evidence.quote: instruments each stage (query, retrieval, generation) with lightweight monitors
factual accuracy, hallucination avoidance, adversarial robustness, bias and fairness, toxicity, security, and calibration

tasks.question: LLM 评测 harness 分为哪几类？
tasks.gold_answer: 分为 benchmark harness、agent harness 和 tool-use harness 三类。

gold_evidence.quote: We distinguish three harness families.

tasks.question: 现有 prompt-injection benchmark 的主要有效性问题是什么？
tasks.gold_answer: 需要验证 robustness 是否能跨 benchmark、vendor 和 defense 迁移；论文用 11 个模型、5 个 vendor 重新评估 ASR。

gold_evidence.quote: evaluate the attack success rate (ASR) of 11 models from five different vendors

tasks.question: Ghost Context 和普通 hallucination 的区别？
tasks.gold_answer: 普通 hallucination 发明不存在的信息；Ghost Context 使用存在但不该影响当前输出的信息，是 misattribution 而不是 fabrication。

gold_evidence.quote: A model exhibiting Ghost Context uses information that is present but should not influence the current output.

tasks.question: 为什么 LLM-based measurement 的可复现性依赖 serving stack？
tasks.gold_answer: 即使强制最可能答案，不同 software/hardware serving stack 仍可能改变输出；self-hosted open-weight 模型自身复现率为 96.6–100%。

gold_evidence.quote: reproducibility depends on the serving stack
Self-hosted standard open-weight models reproduce their own output on 96.6 to 100 percent of cases.

tasks.question: LLM-serving scheduler 排名在不同 workload 上可移植吗？
tasks.gold_answer: 部分可移植：两个 source 的跨源排名一致性可到 Kendall tau 1.0，但涉及 BurstGPT 时可低至 0.55。

gold_evidence.quote: Cross-source rank agreement is strong between two sources (Kendall’s τ b up to 1.0)
as low as 0.55

tasks.question: Agent-Gov-Bench 衡量什么？
tasks.gold_answer: 衡量 governance continuity：runtime failure 时 authorization、approval validity、evidence lineage 和 provenance 是否仍然成立。

gold_evidence.quote: It measures governance continuity

tasks.question: LLM agent 在强制上下文压缩下有哪些 context-management 策略？
tasks.gold_answer: drop 最旧 turns、用 LLM 生成 summary、只检索与当前 query 最相关的 turns；论文在受控 fact-recall 任务上比较。

gold_evidence.quote: dropping the oldest turns, or replacing them with an LLM-generated summary
retrieving only the turns most relevant to the current query

tasks.question: vLLM 和 TensorRT-LLM 的定位差异？
tasks.gold_answer: vLLM 强调 easy、fast、cheap 的 LLM serving；TensorRT-LLM 用 specialized kernels 和 efficient runtime 优化 LLM/Visual Gen inference。

gold_evidence.quote: Easy, fast, and cheap LLM serving for everyone
TensorRT LLM optimizes inference for LLMs and Visual Gen models with specialized kernels

tasks.question: KeepKV 相比传统 KV cache eviction 的优势？
tasks.gold_answer: 传统 eviction 丢弃不重要的 KV entries，造成信息损失和 hallucination；KeepKV 用 merging 保留更多信息，并减少 attention 分布不一致。

gold_evidence.quote: Traditional methods selectively evict less important KV cache entries, which leads to information loss and hallucinations.

tasks.question: EMPIRIC 指出现有 KV cache 压缩方法的什么不足？
tasks.gold_answer: 多数方法只优化 storage 或 computation 之一，无法同时兼顾；且依赖 heuristic token selection，压缩下 accuracy 下降。

gold_evidence.quote: few methods effectively achieve both simultaneously
existing methods primarily rely on heuristic-driven approaches

tasks.question: Query decomposition + cross-encoder reranking 相比 standard single-hop RAG 的目标？
tasks.gold_answer: 处理 multi-hop 查询，跨多文档综合证据，并用 cross-encoder 降低 semantic drift；standard single-hop 往往无法回答这类问题。

gold_evidence.quote: standard single-hop retrieval often fails on complex, multi-hop queries

tasks.question: 候选证据 reranking 和按答案频率选择有什么不同？
tasks.gold_answer: 候选证据 reranking 结合 trajectory ranks、lexical matching 和 event-entity 结构特征；答案频率不一定等于 correction value。

gold_evidence.quote: candidate evidence reranking (CAPE) combines trajectory ranks, lexical matching, and event-entity structural features

tasks.question: Agentic API 命名（BOOK/FIND/QUERY）相比 REST/CRUD 的效果？
tasks.gold_answer: 在 mixed-paradigm 条件下，语义化 agentic method names 提高 endpoint selection accuracy。

gold_evidence.quote: In mixed-paradigm conditions, agentic methods outperform

tasks.question: Tool registry 中 legal puffery 和 fabricated claims 对 agent 选择的影响？
tasks.gold_answer: legal puffery 捕获几乎全部 optimization effect；fabricated claims 没有显著额外偏差，FTC 式披露规则对实际机制无效。

gold_evidence.quote: captures 100% of the optimization effect

tasks.question: 独立 authorization layer 是否显著降低 healthcare agent 的 unsafe actions？
tasks.gold_answer: 没有显著降低：fully governed 0.7% vs unconstrained 0.4%，差异 +0.4 points，95% CI 跨 0，P=0.6875。

gold_evidence.quote: Unsafe actions occurred in 0.7% of fully governed versus 0.4% of unconstrained episodes

tasks.question: 结构化 SECI memory extraction 相比 raw storage 的提升有多大？
tasks.gold_answer: SECI extraction Recall@5 为 93.9%，raw storage 为 92.1%；主导因素是 embedding model，而不是 extraction 本身。

gold_evidence.quote: SECI-based extraction achieves 93.9% Recall@5 versus 92.1% for raw storage
both using the same embedding model and vector database

tasks.question: Self-hosted open-weight 模型和不同 serving stack 的复现率差异？
tasks.gold_answer: self-hosted open-weight 模型可复现自身输出 96.6–100%；但两台机器加载相同模型、不同 stack 时，复现性会下降。

gold_evidence.quote: Self-hosted standard open-weight models reproduce their own output on 96.6 to 100 percent of cases.

tasks.question: KeepKV 如何做 periodic lossless KV cache compression？
tasks.gold_answer: 用 adaptive KV cache merging 保留信息，减少 merging 前后 attention distribution 的不一致，在严格内存约束下保持性能。

gold_evidence.quote: we propose KeepKV , a novel adaptive KV cache merging method

tasks.question: Tamarin 的三层压缩分别是什么？
tasks.gold_answer: L1 是非摘要的 4-bit focal tier；L2 是 3-bit learned group-summary vectors；L3 是 CPU-RAM archive，保存 4-bit compressed originals。

gold_evidence.quote: a non-summarized 4-bit focal tier (L1), a 3-bit tier of learned group-summary vectors (L2), and a CPU-RAM archive of all compressed originals stored at 4-bit precision (L3)

tasks.question: Apt-Serve 如何提升 effective throughput？
tasks.gold_answer: 用 adaptive request scheduling on hybrid cache，缓解 KV cache 限制 batch size 和 FCFS 僵化的问题，提升 TTFT SLO attainment。

gold_evidence.quote: adaptive request scheduling on hybrid cache

tasks.question: Secure-RAG 的评估流程是什么？
tasks.gold_answer: 对 query、retrieval、generation 每个阶段加 lightweight monitors，做多维评估。

gold_evidence.quote: instruments each stage (query, retrieval, generation) with lightweight monitors

tasks.question: OrbitFlow 如何满足长上下文 serving 的 SLO？
tasks.gold_answer: 用 ILP solver 决定哪些层的 KV cache 放在 GPU/host，做细粒度重配置，减少 CPU-to-GPU KV transfer 和延迟尖峰。

gold_evidence.quote: OrbitFlow employs a lightweight ILP solver

tasks.question: KeepKV 和 Tamarin 对 KV cache merging 的安全性判断一致吗？
tasks.gold_answer: 不一致：KeepKV 认为 adaptive merging 可以在保性能的同时保留信息；Tamarin 认为 eviction/merge 会永久破坏未来才相关的信息，主张可逆压缩。

gold_evidence.quote: a novel adaptive KV cache merging method designed to preserve performance under strict memory constraints
which can destroy information that becomes relevant only after the future query is known

tasks.question: Serving benchmark 的排名是否既可移植又可复现？
tasks.gold_answer: 存在张力：scheduler 排名跨源可高度一致（Kendall tau 到 1.0），但 LLM-based measurement 的复现性依赖 serving stack。

gold_evidence.quote: Cross-source rank agreement is strong between two sources (Kendall’s τ b up to 1.0)
reproducibility depends on the serving stack

tasks.question: 现有 prompt-injection benchmark 是否足够可靠？
tasks.gold_answer: 不够：需要验证跨 benchmark/vendor/defense 的可移植性；Secure-RAG 也指出需要统一 harness 和多维评估。

gold_evidence.quote: evaluate the attack success rate (ASR) of 11 models from five different vendors
instruments each stage (query, retrieval, generation) with lightweight monitors

tasks.question: SECI structured extraction 是 agent memory recall 的主要驱动因素吗？
tasks.gold_answer: 不是；93.9% vs 92.1% 的提升很小，论文说主导因素是 embedding model。

gold_evidence.quote: SECI-based extraction achieves 93.9% Recall@5 versus 92.1% for raw storage
both using the same embedding model and vector database

tasks.question: 在 forced context compression 下，哪种 context-management 策略最好？
tasks.gold_answer: 没有单一最优；drop oldest、LLM summary、retrieve relevant turns 各有取舍，需要在受控 fact-recall 任务上比较。

gold_evidence.quote: dropping the oldest turns, or replacing them with an LLM-generated summary
under a controlled, fact-recall task
